<small>''This article is about the Parasite Biome generated by Stage IV Beckons. For the other [[:Category:Work In Progress Content|Work In Progress]] Biome, see [[Harlequin Biome]].''</small>

The '''Parasite Biome''' is a new type of Biome introduced in [[Version 1.9.0]].

==''Info''==
The Parasite Biome can only be created by [[#Node|Nodes]], generated after a Beckon reaches the [[Stage IV Beckon|fourth]] and current final Stage and the [[Ubiquitous Development]] is Level 4.

As the Biome spreads it infects the landscape on a large scale, acting similar to [[Beckon (Disambiguation)|Infestation]]. The Parasite Biome contains a wide variety of [[Biome Blocks|blocks]] both converted from normal blocks and created from scratch.

While in the Parasite Biome, any non-Parasite Entity will have a 50% Regeneration Penalty<ref>Exception for Iron Golems. </ref>. Any non-parasite entity that goes in the Parasite Biome will get the [[Call Of The Hive]] Effect.

Players will see a gray, sinister Fog when inside a Parasite Biome, or inside the [[#Node|Effect Range]] of a Node.

==''Node''==
{{Node Info
|title1=Node
|image1=Node Stage1.png
|crop_growth_failure_chance=30% / 60% / 100%
|effect_range=400 / 1600 / 8000
|spread_range=200 / 800 / 4000
|growth_time=8 / 10 / 40 days
}}
The '''Node''' is the structure that permits the expansion of the Parasite Biome, converting all the blocks it finds into Parasite Biome Blocks, up to a [[Hardness]] value of 60.

Nodes have 3 levels, increasing in level changes the visual appearance of a node and its statistics.

It is a mass of reddish colored blocks, which act as a protection for the Hive Core. In order to truly stop a Parasite Biome expansion, the Hive Core itself must be destroyed, not just the structure around it.

A total of 20 Nodes can exist in one dimension, but they need to be at least 10,000 blocks away from each other. Nodes can only exist in the Overworld, Nether, and End by default.

As long as the [[Stage IV Beckon]] that generated a Node is alive, no matter if the Node is destroyed, another one will be spawned.

When you are inside the Parasite Biome, you will hear a heartbeat sound. The closer you are to the Node, the faster this sound will get.<ref>By default, this sound plays every 30 ticks, at a volume of 0.4.  These configuration options exist to give resource packs that change this sound more versatility.</ref>

Very often structures contain [[Dead Blood]]. This liquid behaves similarly to water but deals immense damage and heals parasites to full in seconds.

=== ''Node Buffs'' ===
Depending on the level of all Nodes in a World added together, Parasites will spawn with certain Effects. 

These being:

*Speed II, which needs 3 Node levels to be applied.
*Fire Resistance I, which needs 4 Node levels to be applied.
*Invisibility I, which needs 7 Node levels to be applied.

== ''Clearance'' ==
If the Node is destroyed, the Stage IV Beckon will create another in a short amount of time. To stop the expansion both the Node and Beckon must be destroyed. Even after the expansion is stopped, the already existing Parasite Biome chunks still remain. The Parasite Biome must be cleared using [[Biome Purifier|Biome Purifiers]]. [[Quench|Quenches]] will not affect the Parasite Biome.
